info.title: Nexo API
info.description: Fiscal centralizing API for integration between sales systems, government and accounting platforms.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of connectors belonging to the given organization.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: ID of the organization to filter connectors by.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 10.

422.description: Validation error — organization_id missing or invalid

items.example: The organization id field is required.

post.description: Creates a connector for the given organization. The token is only returned in this response and cannot be retrieved later.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this connector belongs to.

allowed_events.description: List of event types this connector is allowed to send. Null means all events are allowed.

active.description: Whether the connector is active. Defaults to true.

token.description: Bearer token — only visible at creation.

409.description: Conflict — connector name already exists in this organization

message.example: A connector with the same name already exists in this organization.

get.description: Returns a single connector. The token is never exposed in this response.

put.description: Updates the name, allowed events, and active status. The token and organization cannot be changed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the connector to update.

name.description: New name. Must be unique within the organization.

allowed_events.description: Updated list of allowed event types. Send null to allow all events.

409.description: Conflict — connector name already exists in this organization

message.example: A connector with the same name already exists in this organization.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a connector. Existing integration events referencing this connector will also be removed (cascade).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the connector to delete.

post.description: Ingests an event sent by an external connector (e.g. a POS system). Requires the connector's Bearer token for authentication.

external_event_id.description: Optional UUID from the originating system, used for idempotency. Must be unique across all events.

event_type.description: Type of the event being sent (e.g. invoice.created).

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON object containing the event data.

401.description: Unauthenticated — missing or invalid connector token

403.description: Forbidden — connector is inactive or event type is not allowed

message.example: This connector is not allowed to send events of type invoice.created.

422.description: Validation error — required fields missing or invalid

items.example: The event type field is required.

get.description: Redirects the user to the Xero authorization page to begin the OAuth2 flow. After the user grants access, Xero will redirect to the callback URL.

Handles the callback from Xero after the user authorizes the app. Exchanges the authorization code for tokens and persists the connection. This endpoint is called automatically by Xero — do not call it directly.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: CSRF state token returned by Xero to verify the request origin.

scopes.example: openid email profile offline_access accounting.settings accounting.transactions accounting.contacts

get.description: Fetches the list of contacts from Xero for the given connection.

message.example: Xero connection not found with ID: 99

get.description: Returns a paginated list of organizations. Optionally filter by name using the search parameter.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter organizations by name (case-insensitive partial match).

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 10.

post.description: Creates an organization after validating the request at both HTTP and domain levels. The name must be unique (case-insensitive).

name.description: Organization display name. Must be unique.

tax_id.description: Tax identification number. Digits and hyphens only.

items.example: The organization name must be at least 3 characters long.
The organization's tax ID must be at least 11 characters long.

message.example: An organization with the same name already exists.

get.description: Returns a single organization by its ID.

put.description: Updates an existing organization. The name must remain unique (case-insensitive) across all organizations.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the organization to update.

name.description: Organization display name. Must be unique.

tax_id.description: Tax identification number. Digits and hyphens only.

message.example: An organization with the same name already exists.

items.example: The organization name must be at least 3 characters long.
The organization's tax ID must be at least 11 characters long.

delete.description: Deletes an organization by ID. The operation is rejected if the organization has associated records (e.g. connectors) to avoid orphaned references.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the organization to delete.

409.description: Cannot delete — organization has associated records

message.example: Cannot delete Organization: it has associated records in [connectors].

connectorToken.description: Bearer token issued when a Connector is created. Only visible at creation time.

tags.name: Connectors
tags.description: Endpoints for managing connectors. A connector represents an external system integration point linked to an organization.

tags.name: Integration Events
tags.description: Endpoints for receiving integration events from external connectors.

tags.name: Xero Integration
tags.description: Endpoints for connecting and interacting with the Xero accounting platform via OAuth2.
